context:
Goal: lanes report to triage, the coordinator and the batch runners without a stop.
Problem (rule): you picked a on item 301, but cloud sessions cannot edit settings.json, so the edit needs a session on your Mac.
Based on (read): settings.json on main has 4 allow entries, among them mcp__claude-code-remote__add_repo and mcp__claude-code-remote__archive_session.
Departs from: main, with no allow entry for send_message — adds mcp__claude-code-remote__send_message to permissions.allow.
Meanwhile: lanes retry a refused message through their parent.
holds: The send_message allow entry in claude-settings settings.json.
reply: #1364 failed its first review at 16:51 CST (batch runner 8). It carries a second commit, 8cf80e2d6, which adds the own-branch lease-push line (items 239 a and 257 c) with no test for it. So it is not batched. The coordinator has the fix to ask for. This item stays open until a clean replacement PR merges.
title: On your Mac: add the send_message allow line (your item 301 pick a)
why: Cloud auto mode refuses settings.json edits, so a session on your Mac makes this one edit.
